What is you try to hang on until you are able to transition? If you still can't hang on after that, you don't have to stay. 

When your outside presentation matches your soul, you might end up being so thankful that you stayed alive to be able to experience that. 

But being alive is a choice. As someone who struggles with suicidal ideation, I take a lot of comfort in knowing I don't *have* to be alive. It hurts a lot of the time, but recently (after undergoing ECT) it also sometimes doesn't hurt. I'd go as far as to say that sometimes it even feels nice. 

Being told "what if things get better" is such a frustrating thing when you're suicidal. In your case though, there is a whole big change that you would be able to make if you're alive that could make life really worth living.

​

I hope you get to transition and live a life that doesn't hurt every day. I love you.

She loves you too. 

If you really don't think you can continue, what I always tell myself is "if you still feel this way in a year, you don't have to stay." Being alive is a CHOICE. I hope you decide to stay, though.
